paper_title: Constraints on scalar field dark matter from colocated Michelson interferometers
notes: Paper constrains scalar field dark matter via energy scale parameters Λ_e (electron coupling) and Λ_γ (photon coupling) in the Lagrangian L_int^lin = (φ/Λ_γ)F_μνF^μν/4 - (φ/Λ_e)m_e ψ̄_e ψ_e. These do not map to AxionLimitBench canonical couplings (g_ae, d_e, etc.). Mass range covered: 1.6×10^-12 to 1.0×10^-7 eV. New constraints in previously unconstrained range 2.4-4.3×10^-11 eV and improved limits in 8.2×10^-9 to 6.2×10^-8 eV by up to 3 orders of magnitude. Used cross-correlated Fermilab Holometer twin 40-m interferometers. Report is_new_limit=true but coupling convention is non-standard, so data points cannot be reliably extracted to canonical AxionLimitBench variables.
